newsitem.title: UK: New sugar freight orders cited, Brazil features.
newsitem.headline: New sugar freight orders cited, Brazil features.

text.p: Brazilian ports were again prominent in the list of reported sugar freight business on the London market on Wednesday, shipbrokers said.
New enquiries included an order from Sugar Chartering, which was open for 22,000 tonnes in bulk from Recife to US Gulf/Atlantic. Shipment dates were not yet known precisely.
Cargill quoted for 17/25,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from west coast central America to Baltic/Black Sea/Egyptian Med for prompt shipment.

Of the day's firmer business, Genoc was said to have fixed 14,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Maputo to London for June/July and E D & F Man fixed 12,600 tonnes from Maceio to the Black Sea for June dates.
Lastly, shipbrokers said Czarnikow Rionda fixed 14,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from south Brazil to east Africa/Red Sea/Indian Ocean.

European sugar sources said Syria was believed to have cancelled its tender to buy white and raw sugar. It had tendered to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes of raws for July 15/August 15 shipment.
